title: 2009 AMC 12B Problem 2
statement: Paula the painter had just enough paint for \(30\) identically sized rooms. Unfortunately, on the way to work, three cans of paint fell off her truck, so she had only enough paint for \(25\) rooms. How many cans of paint did she use for the \(25\) rooms?

solutions.text:
Losing \(3\) cans cost her \(5\) rooms, so \(3\) cans paint \(5\) rooms and each room needs \(\dfrac{3}{5}\) of a can.

For \(25\) rooms she used \(25 \cdot \dfrac{3}{5} = 15\) cans.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: The \(3\) lost cans account for the \(5\) rooms she can no longer paint
The ratio of cans to rooms is \(3 : 5\)
